reference: Independent blind reference for wallthinning (SPEC-wallthinning.md rev 2026-10-16.3, model 2026-10-03.wt-2), 114 cases. Route 1: exact rational weighted least squares on decimal years y + d/D, mpmath (60 digits) for square roots and band crossings (scan + bisection). Route 2: 80-digit normal-equation matrix solve, datetime ordinals, closed-form quadratic band crossings. Both routes agree within 1e-12 relative (fit) and 1e-9 a (years).
reference_citations: P. R. Bevington, D. K. Robinson, Data Reduction and Error Analysis for the Physical Sciences, 3rd ed., McGraw-Hill 2003, ch. 6 (weighted least-squares straight line, parameter variances)
JCGM 100:2008 (GUM), section 6 and annex G (coverage factor; z = 1.959963984540054 is the 0.975 normal quantile)

tolerance.rule: SPEC §10: numbers within 1e-7*max(1,|e|) for keys containing 'year', 1e-9*max(1,|e|) otherwise; everything else exact
